season: Game 1.4.002, up to the 2026-10-08 update · Crumble Dungeon weekly boards close Thursday 00:00 KST
lede: Crumble Dungeon (크럼블 던전), the daily score attack on the Holy Golden Drop (황금갓방울): the rules, the top scores and the lineup rules behind them.
caveat: Snapshot of 2026-10-07; no Crumble Dungeon change since 9/23. Scores are players' own screenshots, one server at a time; ranked by score.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.

you.summary: Won in the lineup screen: Milk captain at top displayed ATK, Brightseeker then Figure on the beam, beam thieves out, Milk arriving early. Then retry.
changes: Captain Milk at the top ATK the cookie window shows (the captain's +10% doesn't count); perks Passion Pay plus Rapid Promotion or Like A Family.
Set the ATK order by lowering dealers' levels: Milk, Brightseeker, Figure, Scorpion, Macaron, Cheesecake (the 578G order).
The rest of the 40 only need more power than the excluded cookies.
Level every cookie on the Exclusions page to Lv.1, Bari included; the 578G author also leaves Espresso out.
If Milk walks in late, lower Pomegranate toward Lv.60 (still inside the 40) and drop spare supports.
Use a damage preset, arena or flat-ATK Conquest (no accuracy or focus), and try one move-speed line if Milk arrives late.
Run at least once a day: the daily board pays only on days with a run, and the weekly board keeps only the best.

crumble_dungeon.lede: Crumble Dungeon (크럼블 던전): every owned cookie fights the Holy Golden Drop in a timed run scored on damage, ranked daily and weekly per server.
crumble_dungeon.caveat: Fight length and boss patterns are the wiki's; damage-reduction steps are EOG's model. Entries a day: three base, lobbies show 5, a Gnome Lab node adds one.

rules.title: Entry and keys
rules.body: One Crumble Dungeon Key per run, from the Dungeon menu's Challenge Dungeon (도전 던전) tab. Mileage-shop keys stack above the cap; extras only matter for record attempts.

rules.title: Entries a day: three or five
rules.body: Three a day per the wiki and the newbie guide; lobbies show a counter out of 5, and a Gnome Lab research adds a daily entry.

rules.title: Every cookie enters; the top 40 by power deploy first
rules.body: The 40 highest-power cookies deploy at once and earn nearly the whole score, so levels decide who's in. Each death brings in the next by power.

rules.title: No formation, pets or manual control
rules.body: All owned cookies enter and fight on their own. The in-game first-40 label vanished on 2026-09-23; the rule still holds.

rules.title: Scoring and the timer
rules.body: Score = damage to the Holy Golden Drop (no HP bar). The run ends when the countdown (up to a minute) hits 0 or every cookie dies.

rules.title: Time left and milestones
rules.body: Top runs end with 0.000 s to about 6 s left. Score milestones pay from 400,000 points up to 1,000,000,000,000.

rules.title: Rankings and resets
rules.body: Each server has its own boards. Weekly keeps the week's best run, closes Thursday 00:00 KST; daily ranks only that day's runs, closes at midnight.

rules.title: Reward mail and the daily run
rules.body: Rewards arrive by mail the next day, 12:00-13:00 KST. The day's first run pays 10,000 XP and 3,000 of a gem currency.

rules.title: What the boards pay
rules.body: Daily: research stones, one-minute speed-ups, top-10 pet tickets. Weekly: coins, XP, top-10 crystals; top 100 earns the 황금빛 광채 title. Milestones: crystals, cosmetics.

rules.title: No power penalty reported
rules.body: None reported: no recommended-power gate like the stage's. Score scales with power and levels; score ÷ total power is only a normaliser.
